question: The 36th meeting of 'Parliamentary committee on official language' was chaired by __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Shah**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah chaired the **36th meeting of Parliamentary Committee** on **Official Language in New Delhi.**
 
• He is an Indian politician serving as Minister of Home Affairs in the Government of India, and a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He has previously served as the President of the BJP from 2014 to 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Piyush Goyal:**

 
 
• An Indian politician and the current minister of Railways and Commerce in the Government of India.
 
• He is also a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party and has held various other ministerial portfolios previously.
 
 
 
• **Narendra Modi:**
 
 
• He is the Prime Minister of India, in office since May 2014.
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), a right-wing Hindu nationalist paramilitary volunteer organisation.
 
 
 
• **Rajnath Singh:**
 
 
• He is an Indian politician serving as the Defence Minister of India.
 
• He has previously served as the President of the Bharatiya Janata Party, and has held several other high-profile ministerial portfolios.
